fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (news sitemap) carry title/link/pubDate-style fields. Upstream JSON-LD is passed through close to verbatim, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek, from ld+json (article mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, reconstructed from paragraph tags (article mode). Note: at least one sampled article has a body genuinely truncated mid-word by the upstream CMS -- passed through as-is.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline (article mode) -- always the agency itself, "Kabar" (Organization), on every sample; this is wire-service content, not individually bylined.

category.title: Category
category.description: Section/category label shown on the article page (article mode only), e.g. "Central Asia", "WNG-2026".

sourceCredit.title: Source credit
sourceCredit.description: Optional attributed-source line shown above the article body (article mode only), e.g. "Akorda", "WNG media headquarters" -- absent on agency-original stories with no external source.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL(s), raw passthrough of the ld+json 'image' field (article mode only).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline (latest mode, from the news sitemap).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: ISO 8601 publish timestamp as given by the news sitemap (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
